title: trifolium campestre
intro: Trifolium campestre, commonly known as Field Clover, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its prebiotic properties. The bioactive constituents of Trifolium campestre include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's extracts have been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, including gastrointestinal issues and skin problems, highlighting its potential therapeutic value.
